correctness.rationale: For r,s>=1, eta>0, alpha>=0, use normalized uniform center/exterior vectors and the exterior dark space; the 2x2 blocks have gaps Δ=sqrt(alpha²(r−1)²+4eta²rs) and eta(r+s). The exact central difference t⁴ coefficient is −eta²[alpha²(r−1)²−eta²(r−s)²]/12, yielding necessity. When Δ=eta(r+s), compare exterior amplitudes: phase relation on the s<=r branch and conjugate-phase relation on s>=r, proving every target/time probability. At r=1 alpha is irrelevant and only s=1 works; at r=s alpha(r−1)=0. No distinct-eigenvalue assumption is used. I independently built full weighted A and A−D and compared exterior columns numerically at multiple on-locus profiles/times; finite checks support, but the exact amplitude identities prove universality.
residual_risks: Only uniformly coupled weighted split joins and exterior basis starts are classified; arbitrary coherent or central starts need not satisfy the same criterion.
Numerical diagonalization is corroboration; sufficiency uses analytic two-level formulas.
